Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Too: A collector road rins through the area, wi branch streets on baith sides an short closes aff the branches. Aw the through traffic bides on the collector.
A suburban layoot: a main street wimples atween twa entries, an curvin streets grow aff it, maistly endin in closes, some closin intae loops.
The streets follae the contour lines o the grund, sae they bide near level, jyned by short streets up the brae. Needs a hill or a brae.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.To: A radial centre (roondaboot, avenues an rings) wi windin streets an dead ends aw roond it. A ring road jyns baith, an the avenues o the centre cairry on intae the neibourheid.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Too: Loops o local streets fed by collector roads, wi closes gin ye want them. Guid for quiet hoosin schemes.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superblo: Muckle blocks ringed by roads, wi a netwark o fitpaths inside. Keeps through traffic oot the blocks.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentr: Rings that follae the shape o the wale't area, jyned tae the centre by connectin roads.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.T: A roondaboot in the middle wi straucht avenues rinnin oot tae the perimeter, crossed by roond layers.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.angle.Tooltip: Birls the pattren inside the wale't area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.alignTerrain.To: Turns the grid sae that ae wey o streets follaes the contour lines: thae streets bide near level, the ithers gang strecht up the brae. The angle still adds tae it.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridMode.spacing: Uises a fixed distance atween streets. The nummer o blocks hings on the size o the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridMode.count.T: Divides the wale't area intae the nummer o columns an raws set ablow.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacs.Toolt: Adds dead-end streets atween the grid roads.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacAxis.To: Direction the closes are laid oot in.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacFrequen: Share o the streets that turn intae closes.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacDepth.T: Lenth o ilka close, as a share o the block depth.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacStagger: Swaps the closes fae ae side o the street tae the ither insteid o linin them up.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.capStyle.Toolti: Whit fills the middle o the turnin circle.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeBranchSpaci: Distance atween twa branch streets on the same side o the collector.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSacLen: Lenth o ilka close. It's made shorter whaur needit sae the ends o neebor branches an the perimeter stey clear.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSacSpa: Distance atween twa pairs o closes alang a branch street.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetSpacing.T: Distance keepit atween neebor streets, sae there's room for plots on baith sides.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.curviness.Toolt: Hou muckle the streets bend. At 0% they're straucht.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.loops.Tooltip: Share o streets that jyne anither street tae mak a loop insteid o endin in a close.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.variation.Toolt: Wales anither random layoot. The same value aye gies the same layoot.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.contourLinkSpac: Distance atween twa brae links alang a level street. Links are niver steeper nor 15%.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.mixedCoreRadius: Radius o the radial centre. On a nerra airt the centre is made smaw, or left oot.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenues.Tooltip: Nummer o straucht avenues leavin the roondaboot, evenly spaced. An avenue that wad meet the perimeter at ower ticht an angle is left oot.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.loopCollectorSp: Distance atween the collector roads that feed the loops.
Size o ilka block inside the superblock. Bigger values gie fewer, bigger blocks.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.rings.Tooltip: Nummer o rings inside the shape. The maist hings on the size o the wale't area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.concentricConne: Nummer o roads that link the rings, fae the perimeter tae the centre.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutRadiu: Radius o the middle roondaboot. The least it can be growes wi the nummer o avenues, sae their junctions bide faur eneuch apairt.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.followTerrain.T: Roads follae the heicht o the grund insteid o bidin level.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueMedianTre: Adds trees on the central reservation.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueMedianGra: Adds gress on the central reservation.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerrainFlat: This area's ower flat: there's nae contour lines tae follae. Wale an area on a hill or a brae.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.zone.Toolt: Zone pentit automatic alang the new roads eftir they're biggit. Juist toom cells is zonit: zonin an biggins that's there awready is niver chynged.
